Welcome! I'm so glad you're here, because together, we're about to step into a world where artificial intelligence is turning what we thought we knew about economics completely upside down.
Imagine a place where machines predict outcomes with incredible accuracy, and suddenly, the old boundaries between human intuition and automated insight start to fade. Kinda wild, right? It makes you wonder—who really has the power when prediction is no longer just a human gift?
As we explore these ideas, we'll see how technology is shaking up the way organizations, markets, and even entire societies make decisions. Some will thrive, others might struggle to keep up, but every one of us is touched by these changes.
In Power And Prediction: The Disruptive Economics of Artificial Intelligence, Ajay Agrawal invites us to look closer at how AI is rewriting the rules for businesses and everyday life alike. We’ll dive into stories and real-world examples, uncovering how predictive tech is shifting costs, changing who comes out ahead, and sometimes, leaving a few folks behind.
So, if you’ve ever wondered how artificial intelligence is shaping the future—or what it means for you and me—let’s find out together. There’s a lot to discover, and I promise, it’s going to be an eye-opening journey.
